claim: How do you recognize fake profiles and bots across any dating app?
summary: Here’s how I avoid bots/scammers. I ask to do a video chat. If they decline, they’re fake. I also tell myself I won’t give anybody any amount of money if I don’t know them very, very well. Even real people should not be hitting you up for money like that. Say this to yourself over and over again: I will not give a dating app person any money whatsoever! That should help. I’m sorry ...
